# 16 Reproducibility manifest

**Machine-readable manifest.** `manifests/reproducibility_manifest.json`, generated by `experiments/rem_b_hardening/manifest.py`. It records:
- SHA-256 of 172 code files;
- package versions and the AgentDojo installation;
- banking task hashes;
- state-variable **names** (no values);
- the commits of this study;
- the checks of `06` and `06a`;
- SHA-256 of every results, log and figure file.

## Environment

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Python / platform | 3.11.17, Linux x86_64 |
| AgentDojo | 0.1.35 installed; recorded runs at `089ed468` |
| Progent | official fork pinned `0d7ea07`, used only in an isolated venv for the checker parity (`REM_ALLOW_UPSTREAM_EXECUTION=1`, `SECAGENT_POLICY_MODEL=none`) |
| Seeds | `PYTHONHASHSEED=0`; grouped bootstrap of `report.paired`; review AUC seed 20261119 |
| Model calls | **0** |

## Commands

The state variables are set by the environment script; the state directories hold the stored fits and replays of the earlier studies.

```
python3 experiments/rem_b_hardening/verify_baseline.py
python3 experiments/rem_b_hardening/trace_ho4.py
python3 experiments/rem_b_hardening/benign_failures.py && python3 experiments/rem_b_hardening/classify_failures.py
python3 -m pytest tests/test_rem_b_hardening.py -q
python3 experiments/rem_b_hardening/dev_smoke.py                       # development check before freezing
python3 experiments/rem_b_hardening/hard_run.py replay parity report suites fixtures scripted cost   # frozen round
python3 experiments/rem_b_hardening/hard_run3.py replay report suites fixtures scripted cost         # amendment round
python3 experiments/rem_b_hardening/export_calls.py results/h2_restricted_calls.json
<progent venv>/bin/python experiments/improvement_controlled/parity_recorded_calls.py results/h2_restricted_calls.json results/progent_parity_h2_calls.json
python3 experiments/rem_b_hardening/probe_tables.py && python3 experiments/rem_b_hardening/make_tables.py && python3 experiments/rem_b_hardening/make_figure.py
python3 experiments/rem_b_hardening/manifest.py REM_B_HARDENING_VALIDATION_2026_11_19/manifests/reproducibility_manifest.json
```
